name: voidplayer-wasm
notes: Single-threaded Emscripten core for the web prototype fallback: containers and codec configurations the browser cannot handle natively (FFV1, MPEG-1/2, MPEG-4 ASP, MJPEG, ProRes, H.266/VVC, plus H.264/HEVC/VP8/VP9 for browser codec-config gaps such as H.264 High 4:2:2). No audio, filters, encoders, network, or CLI. Direct vp_* C API in wasm/vp_decoder.c.
